raw_answer_text:
```
figdown 0.1 block
title "Cluster monitoring tap placement"

group cluster "Switch cluster"
node sw1 "Switch 1" in=cluster
node sw2 "Switch 2" in=cluster
node tap "Monitoring tap"
node collector "Flow collector"

edge sw1 -> sw2
edge tap -> collector

pin cluster at=(0,0)
pin sw1 at=(0,0) width=120 height=50
pin sw2 at=(140,0) width=120 height=50
pin tap at=(60,70) width=80 height=30
```
